faq.q: What is the origin of Twalib?
faq.a: Twalib is associated with Arabic. Twalib is the Swahili form of Arabic طَالِب (Ṭālib), meaning 'seeker, student'.
Yes — the underlying form طَالِب is Arabic.
Twalib can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Twalib should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṭālib is not a Quranic personal name.
